answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 12240 Country: India Title: I am a sunni muslim from Assam, India but now I live in Abha, Saudi Arabia. Here Asr prayer is performed almost 2.30 hours before sunset. Should I follow this timing (both in jamat and alone) or stick to the timing (not performing asr prayer 1.30 hours before sunset) I used to follow in India. Question: I am a sunni muslim from Assam, India but now I live in Abha, Saudi Arabia. Here Asr prayer is performed almost 2.30 hours before sunset. Should I follow this timing (both in jamat and alone) or stick to the timing (not performing asr prayer 1.30 hours before sunset) I used to follow in India. Answer ID: 12240 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1059/830=H/1430) In the question mentioned above, you can sometime perform salah with jama?ah instead of performing it alone. But, you should not make it habit. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
